Clinical history (case record; may contain prior observations):
age: 21
gender: female
history: A case of azygos vein dilatation in a 21-year-old female with scimitar syndrome is presented. Scimitar syndrome and azygos vein dilatation (13 mm) were detected on doing a chest X-ray, CT angiography
and MR angiography. To our knowledge, this is the first such case reported in the literature for azygos vein dilatation in a patient with scimitar syndrome.
